record.question: To effectively carry out registration systems and control the movement of patient files in order to achieve a unit record is the job responsibility for:
record.explanation: Answer C: Medical Record Technician. The Medical Record Technician is responsible for registration/file-control processes and tracking patient records in a unit-record system. Reference: https://cbhidghs.mohfw.gov.in/medical-record-department-training-centre-safdarjung-hospital-new-delhi. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
